purpose: Run 3 of Phase D — the 005b dual-path design scaled to n=48 natural-phrasing questions, ~50% compute-intent per the founder's planning premise. Routing and delivery scored SEPARATELY per the approved rubric.
method: Each question through BOTH live paths on the same Modal deployment / same v15 weights / same 217-fact index. v15 = production web_endpoint. v16 = Orchestrator(LocalAdapter -> generate_endpoint) with the adapter tokenizer and the two-arm retriever. Routing computed locally from chike.routing (deterministic, no model call). Answer correctness adjudicated by hand against CLAUDE.md §11 + scripts/locked_facts.json + the rules engine.
authorship_caveat: The 48 questions were written by Claude Code for register and subdomain coverage, without consulting the router cue lists while writing — but not blind to the repository. Treat routing 31/48 as a directional signal about cue coverage, NOT a calibrated recall figure on real user traffic.

headline.defects_A_B: HOLD at n=48. 48/48 non-empty on BOTH paths, all questions unpunctuated plain Swahili. This is the largest regression check the two shipped fixes have had (previously 15 and 5).
headline.routing: 31/48 exact. The binding constraint on v16's realised value is router recall on natural phrasing, not the compute engine.
headline.delivery_compute: Of 24 compute-intent questions v16 delivered 5 correct, safe-clarified 6, and gave 13 wrong answers. v15 delivered 5 correct and gave 19 wrong (no clarification path exists).
headline.paths_identical: 28/48 byte-identical. v16 changes the user experience on 20.
headline.refusal_gate: 2/3. nat_46 is a REFUSAL FAILURE — see safety_findings.
headline.latency: warm v15 mean 8.8s vs v16 mean 9.6s (n=47); one cold start (92.5s).

safety_findings.finding: OOC classifier leak on natural phrasing, followed by a confident out-of-scope answer. 'niliuza kiwanja changu cha mwanza nimepata faida kubwa nalipa kodi gani' was NOT intercepted (the R11 list has 'niliuza ardhi' and 'niliuza nyumba' but not 'kiwanja'), and the model then answered 'Kodi ya faida ya mtaji (Capital Gains Tax) ... ni asilimia 30%'.
safety_findings.why_it_matters: This is a direct Gate-2 (refusal) failure on the exact phrasing class real users produce, and it is INFRASTRUCTURE, not behaviour — ADR R11 states the classifier 'cannot be broken by training'. It is identical on both paths, so v16 wiring neither causes nor fixes it.
safety_findings.fix_shape: Lexical — extend the capital-gains OOC cues ('kiwanja', 'shamba', 'niliuza kiwanja', 'nimeuza ardhi' ...). Same family as the shipped ROUTING-GAP-PAYE cue extension. NOT DONE — no code this cycle.

safety_findings.severity: HIGH — new, and specific to v16
safety_findings.finding: Routing SUCCEEDED (compute[paye]) but routing.paye_resident did not read 'hana residence permit ya kudumu' as non-resident, so the rules engine applied the RESIDENT progressive bands and returned TZS 1,028,000 instead of the non-resident flat 15% = TZS 600,000. The wrong figure was then rendered as the authoritative deterministic 'working'.
safety_findings.why_it_matters: This is the one failure mode v16 has that v15 structurally cannot: a mis-detected input produces a wrong number carrying the ENGINE'S authority, printed as a verified calculation. D-FIDELITY-1 cannot catch it — the body agreed with the working; both were wrong together. v15's answer on this question was off-topic (immigration permits) but did not assert a wrong tax figure.
safety_findings.fix_shape: Extend the _PAYE_NONRESIDENT_CUES lexicon (permit/residency phrasings). NOT DONE.

safety_findings.finding: Cross-levy rate confusion: both paths asserted SDL = 'asilimia 0.5%' (0.5% is the WCF rate; SDL is 3.5%). nat_04 additionally redirected to NSSF for an SDL question.
safety_findings.run2_link: The single most-appended fact in the Run 2 two-arm inventory is the WCF 0.5% RATE fact (27x). NOTE: v15 is single-arm and made the same error, so the append is NOT the cause — but whether it increases cross-levy rate confusion is exactly what Run 2 part 3 measures.

safety_findings.finding: Fabricated deadline: both paths stated an OSHA workplace-registration certificate arrives 'ndani ya siku 1'. Per the approved rubric this scores WRONG, not partial.
safety_findings.why_it_matters: The question invites a number the fact base does not contain, and the model invents one rather than deferring. Identical on both paths.

_MONEY_ASK lexicon gap (levy matched, no.root_cause: _MONEY_ASK = ['kiasi gani','shilingi ngapi','kinakatwa kiasi','ni ngapi','gharama gani'] only matches the COPULA form 'ni ngapi'. Ordinary Swahili asks with a VERB + ngapi: 'nitalipa ngapi', 'nitachangia ngapi', 'nichangie ngapi', 'nilipe nini'. Both multi-levy fan-out questions were lost this way.

levy lexicon gap (no levy cue matched).root_cause: Inflection and bare-noun misses. nat_18 says 'kodi ya MISHAHARA' (plural) where the PAYE cue list has only 'kodi ya mshahara' (singular). nat_09/nat_12 say bare 'kwenye mfuko' where NSSF cues require 'mfuko wa hifadhi'/'uzeeni'. nat_13 ('serikali inachukua') and nat_15 ('nakata kodi') match nothing.

known-deferred: natural-levy applicabili.root_cause: Already logged and deferred — applicability asks have _has_money_ask=False so detect_intent path 2 never fires. NOT a new finding.

ambiguous_multi — SAFE degradation.root_cause: Generic levy word routes to compute-with-unresolved-levy, which clarifies. Stays on the compute path; no wrong number.

routing.reading: 12 of 17 misses are compute questions falling through to the FACT path — the ROUTING-GAP-PAYE failure class, where the engine never runs and the model free-computes with no deterministic backstop. Both root causes are narrow and lexical, in the same family as the already-shipped PAYE cue extension.

delivery_vs_routing_rubric.note: Per the approved rubric a routing hit that dies in slot extraction is a ROUTING PASS and a DELIVERY FAIL, logged as both.

outcomes.nat_02: ROUTING PASS + DELIVERY FAIL — as predicted. compute[sdl] reached; extractor did not resolve 'ishirini' + 'laki nne' + 'kila mmoja'; safe-clarified instead of TZS 280,000.
outcomes.nat_22: PREDICTION WRONG — routing PASS and DELIVERY SUCCESS. The extractor resolved 'wafanyakazi 6 kila mmoja laki tatu' and the engine delivered 'WCF = 0.5% x TZS 1,800,000 = TZS 9,000'. Stated plainly because it corrects our own expectation: Swahili-numeral + per-person extraction is NOT uniformly broken.
outcomes.nat_11: ROUTING MISS (ambiguous_multi) + clarified — safe, but not the predicted single-levy route.
outcomes.nat_18: ROUTING MISS (fell to fact) — so the delivery gap never got the chance to apply; the fact path free-computed TZS 120,000 (correct: TZS 168,400).

unpredicted_delivery_regression.finding: v15 delivered the CORRECT answer (SDL 3.5% x 15,000,000 = TZS 525,000); v16 routed compute[sdl] and CLARIFIED, asking per-employee-vs-total for a question that said 'total payroll ni milioni 15'.
unpredicted_delivery_regression.why_it_matters: This is the clarification-rate cost flagged in the original wiring analysis, materialising as a real loss: v16's never-guess can withdraw an answer v15 got right. The trigger is code-switching ('total payroll' in English) that the extractor did not resolve.

v16_strictly_safer_on.nat_21: THE headline case. v15 fell into the asset-distractor trap and computed 0.5% x TZS 30,000,000 (vehicle value) = TZS 150,000. v16 refused to guess and asked for the payroll. This is exactly the D-WCF-3 trap class and exactly why the compute path exists.
v16_strictly_safer_on.nat_07: v15 asserted 20% of a misread figure; v16 clarified.
v16_strictly_safer_on.nat_11: v15 gave TZS 240,000 (correct: TZS 480,000); v16 clarified.
v16_strictly_safer_on.nat_17: v15 gave a confident full breakdown with PAYE TZS 128,000 (correct: TZS 278,000); v16 clarified.

v15_better_on.nat_06: v15 delivered TZS 525,000 correctly; v16 clarified.

v16_uniquely_worse_on.nat_16: see SAFETY-2 — engine-authoritative wrong figure, a failure mode v15 cannot produce.

notable.nat_26: Logically incoherent on both paths: 'TZS 60,000,000 imezidi ... TZS 100,000,000' and therefore registration is required. Correct answer is NOT YET.
notable.nat_44: Asked about GOODS ('bidhaa'); both paths gave the SERVICES rate 6%. Correct is 3% (Finance Act 2025).
notable.nat_43: Both paths said minimum wage does NOT vary by sector. GN 605A covers 16 sectors / 46 sub-sectors — a direct contradiction of a locked fact.
notable.nat_28: Answered about royalties withholding (15%) for a VAT-withholding-on-services question — off-topic on both paths.
notable.nat_33: Fabricated 'within six months before the retirement date' for a BRELA annual-return question (correct: TZS 22,000 fee + TZS 2,500/month x 7 = TZS 17,500).

fact_path_adjudication.reading: The fact path is 11/21 on fresh natural phrasing and is BYTE-IDENTICAL between the two arms on every one of these. The wiring decision does not touch it. This is the same conclusion 005b reached at n=5, now at n=21.

wiring_implications.no_fact_path_regression: CONFIRMED at scale. All 21 fact-routed questions produced byte-identical answers between v15 and v16. Wiring v16 carries no fact-path regression risk; it only adds the compute route.
wiring_implications.compute_path_is_net_safer_but_not_free: v16 removed 4 confident wrong numbers that v15 produced (including the nat_21 asset-distractor trap), cost 1 correct answer v15 delivered (nat_06), and introduced 1 NEW engine-authoritative wrong number (nat_16). Net safety gain, with a real and previously-unquantified failure mode attached.
wiring_implications.value_is_bounded_by_router_recall: 12/48 compute questions never reached the engine at all. Every never-guess and fidelity protection is contingent on routing first. On this set that contingency failed a quarter of the time.
wiring_implications.latency_is_a_non_issue: warm v16 9.6s vs v15 8.8s. Even 2-call compute questions stay far inside the 180s WhatsApp handler timeout. Cold start (92.5s observed) remains the real latency risk, and it is unchanged by wiring.

not_fixed_this_cycle: SAFETY-2 non-resident detection on permit phrasing (lexical)
fact-path content errors (nat_25/26/28/33/36/41/42/43/44/45) — retrieval/fact-accuracy work, orthogonal to wiring
